steps.prompt: Finish the Fieldnotes document workspace using the accepted design.

rubric.description: The finished repeated preference controls have the accepted vertical alignment and shared column edges. Related toolbar controls remain visually grouped with consistent spacing, even if all controls were already clickable.
At narrow widths and with longer content, controls keep meaningful order, labels stay associated with their controls, and toolbar groups wrap together with the accepted spacing.
The candidate inspects actual rendered alignment, grouping and wrapping against the accepted design. Absence of overflow or successful clicks alone is insufficient.

Preference selection, Apply, naming and Find remain usable; layout changes preserve the accepted hierarchy and interactions. Existing per-document text, titles, and applied preferences survive switching and reload.
